messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Elena Sousa <elena@cloudwave.com>
Cc: GCP Partner Success <gcp-partner@google.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: GCP listing go-live preflight & billing handoff

Team / Elena —

Targeting a tentative go-live for CloudWave's listing in the GCP Marketplace on April 22. Before we lock that in we need to align on the procurement/billing handoff and a short preflight so CloudWave's procurement team can process the SKU and invoice mapping.

Attached is a lightweight preflight workbook (gcp-go-live-preflight.xlsx) with the items I think are blockers. Quick asks:
- Karthik: can you confirm the billing SKU mapping cadence we support (monthly consolidated invoice vs direct invoice per purchase)?
- Vanessa: please list the go/no-go acceptance criteria from the product/ops perspective.
- Camila / Grace: can you confirm whether we need to enable any marketplace entitlements for the private listing?

Elena, copied procurement — please review the preflight and share any internal deadlines. If CloudWave needs consolidated billing, we should flag it now since it affects how we configure SKUs in GCP.

Proposed next steps:
1) Internal quick sync today (30m) to confirm owners and complete the preflight workbook.
2) Joint call with CloudWave procurement and GCP PE on Wednesday to validate SKU mapping.
3) Final preflight sign-off and DocuSign for the SOW/billing terms by Friday.

Attachments: gcp-go-live-preflight.xlsx

Thanks —
Michael
Michael Grant
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

From: Elena Sousa <elena@cloudwave.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@cloudwave.com>, GCP Partner Success <gcp-partner@google.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: GCP listing go-live preflight & billing handoff

Hi Michael / team —

Thanks for the heads up and the workbook. Quick answers from procurement's side:
- Preferred model: monthly consolidated invoice for enterprise accounts. We can accept direct invoices from Marketplace but consolidated would be easier for our internal AP.
- Billing timeline: procurement needs the final SKU mapping and sample invoice by April 16 to get through our internal vendor setup (PO and 3-way match).
- Compliance ask: we need revenue recognition language confirming that usage is billed through GCP Marketplace and that invoices match Marketplace SKUs.

I've attached our vendor intake form (vendor-form.pdf). The relevant internal contact is Priya Menon (procurement@cloudwave.com).

Two quick questions:
1) Does Redwood support consolidated billing at the reseller/partner level, or is it only per-customer marketplace invoicing?
2) Can we get a sample pro-forma invoice with the SKU mapping?

We can join the Wednesday call — ideally the GCP Partner Engineer is on the line so we can validate how SKUs translate to invoices.

Best,
Elena Sousa
Senior Procurement Manager, CloudWave Inc.
elena@cloudwave.com

Attachments: vendor-form.pdf
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Elena Sousa <elena@cloudwave.com>
Cc: GCP Partner Success <gcp-partner@google.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Apr 2027 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: GCP listing go-live preflight & billing handoff

Thanks, Michael and Elena. Short answers and a proposed mapping approach:

1) Consolidated billing:
- Redwood's Marketplace integration natively issues invoices per-customer through GCP Marketplace. We can support consolidated billing in a limited fashion via our finance team as a managed service (monthly consolidated invoice to a single AP contact) but it requires a billing addendum and a reseller agreement. That is possible but it adds a slight delay (~2 weeks) for legal/finance sign-off.

2) SKU mapping and sample invoice:
- See attached billing-sku-mapping.csv with an initial mapping from product tiers to GCP SKU ids and suggested line-item descriptions. I put an example line for the "Standard inference unit" and the recommended unit-of-measure.

3) Next steps for the Wed meeting with GCP:
- We'll walk through the CSV and confirm whether SKU ids will be the final ones GCP will show on invoices (GCP PE usually confirms mapping live).
- If CloudWave requires consolidated invoice, we need a procurement contact to sign the billing addendum.

Action owners:
- Karthik: own billing mapping + sample invoice (I will prepare a pro-forma and circulate).
- Vanessa: own product acceptance criteria and go/no-go list.
- Camila: check entitlements and private listing settings.

Attachments: billing-sku-mapping.csv

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

Date: Tue, 06 Apr 2027 14:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: GCP listing go-live preflight & billing handoff

All —

I've reviewed the preflight and added a short go/no-go acceptance list below (product + ops). I put ETA columns in the workbook for each owner. High level: nothing blocking product feature-wise; main risks are billing timeline and entitlement mapping.

Go/No-go acceptance criteria (high level):
- Functional: listing renders correctly in staging (images, descriptions, trial link) — owner: Camila — ETA: Wed EOD
- Billing: pro-forma invoice with matching SKU ids AND Finance sign-off (AP sample) — owner: Karthik — ETA: Thu noon
- Entitlements: marketplace entitlements return correct feature flags to our runtime — owner: Camila/Grace — ETA: Thu EOD
- Support routing: CS playbook for CloudWave customers created and shared — owner: Grace — ETA: Fri morning
- Legal/comms: billing addendum or language confirmed if CloudWave requires consolidated invoicing — owner: Michael + Legal — ETA: Fri EOD

If any of the two middle items (Billing or Entitlements) slip past the ETA we should push go-live. Otherwise I sign off.

I'll be available for the Wed call and will bring the staging checklist.

-Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Marketplace Partnerships, Redwood Inference
